intent: Make the below-the-fold dashboard panels feel like one cohesive, IDE-like Oyatie product instead of independent slices by adding a persistent lower command shell context ribbon synchronized with the Product Activity Spine.
product_direction: Oyatie will build a hyperscaler-grade cloud substrate and dogfood all FD-001 microservices as tenant workloads on that substrate. FD-001 product delivery remains the master-plan product goal; Oyatie Cloud is the substrate that proves the platform can host real production tenants.
implementation_summary: Added a Command Shell Substrate ribbon below the top activity spine and metrics so lower panels inherit a single active route, target, status, and local-boundary state.
Added route controls for FD-001, Action Inbox, Workflow, Comms, Finance, Identity, Cloud, and Evidence.
Extended the shared local route dispatcher with Daily/Finance/Identity route copy and synchronization into the new command shell fields.
Added an IntersectionObserver-based lower-panel context observer that updates the command shell and global spine when major panels scroll into view.
Styled the ribbon using the same flat Bominal/corp-web-inspired operator grammar, with responsive tablet/mobile stacking and no horizontal page overflow.

before_metrics.issue: After the Product Activity Spine, the top-fold route model was cohesive, but lower-dashboard panels still lacked a persistent context header tying Finance, Identity, Cloud, Evidence, Work Hub, and Workflow into one operating shell.

interaction_assertions: The SSR page contains #command-shell-substrate with FD-001 selected and #service-catalog as its default target.
Clicking Finance updates active route/status/target, selects Finance, routes to #finance-commercial-suite, and keeps the lower command shell synchronized.
Clicking Identity updates active route/status/target, selects Identity, routes to #identity-workforce-suite, and keeps the lower command shell synchronized.
Clicking Evidence updates active route/status/target, selects Evidence, and routes to the resource/audit console without backend mutation.
The scroll context observer updates the command shell when lower panels enter view.
responsive_assertions: 1440x1000: command shell renders and routes with no horizontal page overflow (scrollWidth == innerWidth == 1440).
1024x900: command shell stacks with no horizontal page overflow (scrollWidth == innerWidth == 1024).
390x844: command shell remains usable as a two-column route grid with no horizontal page overflow (scrollWidth == innerWidth == 390).

visual_verdict.category_match: Professional operator command shell with cohesive lower-dashboard context, Bominal-like route/status discipline, and visual-only interactivity.
differences_remaining: The page is still a broad full-dashboard mockup rather than a single compact IDE viewport; lower panels now share context but have not all been re-composed into one canvas.
visual_verdict.reasoning: The new lower command shell directly addresses below-the-fold fragmentation by syncing Finance, Identity, Cloud, Evidence, Action Inbox, Workflow, and Comms into the same route/status model as the top Product Activity Spine. It improves cohesion without copying Bominal or adding backend behavior.
